class_rule: Each entry's class is that of its primary part, the part that answers the entry's own question (for r3-P22 and r4-P08 the unfunded arm; for r3-P54 stage B by people; for r3-P13, r3-P72 and r4-P19 the registered test; for r4-P16 its audio part). shared_rules: Floor rule (stat): no reading looser than 'the near 90% creator-interval bound lies beyond half the smallest effect'; reading A also needs every named control row in the same direction; disagreeing estimators or references give 'undetermined'.
Smallest effects are fixed in r3-P29 on substantive grounds and never lowered after r3-P70 is seen.
Agreement, never accuracy: every label is model-coded and not checked by a person.

Agnosticism sentence, form (b) with emic's amendment: 'No measure in this study can tell whether a non-human source speaks; every measure describes the speech in these recordings and how the creators present it.'
